messages.text:
Hallo HeliumDeplay Team,
 
ja, leider braucht man bei der Bestellung sehr viel Geduld. 
Ich mache mir etwas Sorge um den Turbo-Modus, der in vielen Tests auf
Youtube leider zur Abschaltung wegen Hitzeproblemen geführt hat.
 
Bin gespannt, wenn es denn endlich nach Deutschland ankommt.
 
Viele Grüße
 
André
 
Hello HeliumDeplay Team, yes, unfortunately, ordering requires a lot of
patience. I'm a bit worried about the turbo mode, which, in many YouTube tests,
has unfortunately led to shutdowns due to overheating. I'm curious to see when
it finally arrives in Germany. Best regards, André
 
 
Gesendet: Dienstag, 3. November 2026 um 13:20
Von: "HeliumDeploy Support" <(email hidden)>
An: "Andre T." <(email hidden)>
Betreff: We let you down on your Magic Miner 40T, and we're sorry

Hi Andre,

I want to start with an apology, because you deserve one. You trusted us with
your order, and we gave you a ship date we did not keep. Then we gave you
another one, and we missed that too. That is on us. You should never have had to
wonder where your miner is or chase us for answers.

Here is the full story, without spin.

The first units were planned for September. The final prototype only reached our
team on September 15, and once the design was approved, the first units were due
to ship 30 days later, on October 15. During that first production run, Magic
Miner stopped the line because of a problem with the control board. That problem
is now fixed, and the final version of the machine has been approved.

Building a brand new miner is hard, and some of this was outside our control.
But the dates we gave you were not. We were too optimistic, we did not build in
enough margin, and we did not keep you informed the way we should have. We own
that completely.

Here is what we are doing about it:

 * Instead of shipping in small batches, all 300 units are being built and
   shipped together, so nobody waits on a later batch.
 * Our partner from Harlo Labs, who is in China right now, is visiting the
   factory in person this Thursday, November 5, to see the units being built and
   packed with his own eyes.
 * Magic Miner expects the units to ship out from the factory on November 12.
 * The moment your miner ships to you, you will get your tracking number by
   email. You will not have to ask.

The new HQ01 control board
[https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0584/2419/7302/files/mm40t-hq01-control-board.jpg?v=1793707146]
A finished Magic Miner 40T hashboard
[https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0584/2419/7302/files/mm40t-hashboard.jpg?v=1793707141]

The new control board and a finished hashboard from the current production run.

Our partner from Harlo Labs will also be sending you new photos and videos
straight from the factory floor, so you can see your miner come together for
yourself.

We have had the 40T running in our own hands, and so have the reviewers who
tested it early, and it has impressed every one of us. We are confident it will
exceed your expectations too, and that it will be worth the wait.

You were one of the very first people to believe in this machine, back when it
was $649. That meant a lot to us, and we have not forgotten it. Your patience is
going to pay off.

If you have any question at all, just reply to this email. A real person will
answer.

Thank you for sticking with us. We will make this right.

HeliumDeploy Support
